diagnosis: The 42,018,190,584-byte published transformer is larger than the worker's 31,403,802,624-byte host-memory cgroup. safetensors therefore failed its whole-file mmap before model loading, inference, or VRAM allocation.
failure_excerpt: RuntimeError: unable to mmap 42018190584 bytes from file </workspace/LTX-2/models/ltx-2.5/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-dev-transformer-bf16.safetensors>: Cannot allocate memory (12)
mitigation: Tensor payloads were copied byte-for-byte into independently mmap-able shards, the loader was extended to resolve shard directories, and disk streaming was changed to retain at most one active shard mapping.

Warm sunlight reflects in amber streaks across puddles and slick asphalt while storefront signs and passing traffic blur softly in the background. A light breeze stirs their coat and nearby tree leaves. Cars roll slowly in the distance, tires hiss on wet pavement, footsteps splash naturally, and a muted city ambience of engines, distant voices, and a soft crosswalk signal remains synchronized. Realistic motion, natural anatomy, cinematic shallow depth of field, warm highlights, cool rain shadows, subtle lens flare, no cuts.
